title: Planet Crisis Response — Hurricane Melissa, Jamaica (2025)
description: Planet Crisis Response Program imagery documenting Hurricane Melissa's impact on Jamaica. Melissa made landfall in southwestern Jamaica on 28 October 2025 as a catastrophic Category 5 hurricane. The catalog is split into **post-event** high-resolution SkySat collects (~0.8 m) acquired 3–4 November 2025 over the landfall zone, and a **pre-event** SkySat baseline (Oct 2023, the most recent cloud-free SkySat of these locations before the storm) for before/after comparison — both organised by affected location (Savanna-la-Mar, Black River). Each Item bundles the visual and pansharpened COGs plus usable-data masks (UDM2/UDM). Imagery © Planet Labs PBC, licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0.
